newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 4.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
- The U.S. presidential election campaign has failed to inspire most voters, who remain cynical.
- A New York Times/CBS News Poll shows 47 percent of probable voters support Democractic House candidates against 41 percent who back Republicans.
- President Bill Clinton remains in the lead in the latest New York Times/CBS News poll.
- Campaign workers sought to encourage potential voters to support their candidates during the last weekend before the elections.
